title: ONSure Learning Promotion Receipt v1
description: 149_LEARNING_VALIDATION_SCHEMA_FIXTURE_SPECIFICATION.md SS B. Records exactly one state transition of a LearningCandidateAsset. 148 P0 invariant 2: a direct CANDIDATE->ACTIVE transition is forbidden -- the allowed_transitions enum below only permits the adjacent-stage transitions a real qualification pipeline goes through (mirroring OfficialLearningLedger's own CANDIDATE->...->APPLIED_LOCK staging), so a receipt claiming to skip straight from CANDIDATE to ACTIVE is a schema-level rejection, not just a runtime check.

allOf.description: 148 P0 invariant 2: candidate creator and final approver being the same actor is enforced by the cross-contract validator against LearningCandidateAsset.created_by, not expressible from this schema in isolation.
